title: Ampleness of a line bundle on one fibre of a proper morphism spreads to an open neighbourhood of the base point
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a proper morphism f : X -> Y and an invertible sheaf L whose restriction to the fibre over y is ample, the lemma finds an open neighbourhood V of y such that L restricted to f^{-1}(V) is ample relative to V. The retained proof: reduce to Y affine; present X -> Y as the limit of a directed system of proper morphisms X_i -> Y_i with Y_i of finite type over Z and affine transition maps (Limits, lemma-proper-limit-of-proper-finite-presentation-noetherian); descend L to a compatible system of line bundles L_i (Limits, lemma-descend-invertible-modules); use the colimit of residue fields to find a stage where the fibre bundle is ample (Limits, lemma-limit-ample); apply the finite-type case (Cohomology of Schemes, lemma-ample-in-neighbourhood) to get V_i; pull back V_i along Y -> Y_i, closing with base change of ample bundles, affineness of X -> Y x_{Y_i} X_i, and ampleness under affine pullback (Morphisms, lemmas ample-base-change and pullback-ample-tensor-relatively-ample). The statement carries a reference environment citing EGA IV Corollary 9.6.4. Retained author proof at lines 14165-14194.
